title: CoWriter: Guiding Methodological and Synergetic Human-LLM Co-Authoring
abstract: arXiv:2610.31277v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While LLMs have transformed text generation, standard chat-and-canvas interfaces often reduce human authoring to quite passive supervision, causing review fatigue, over-reliance on AI, and the sidelining of the human role in long-form, source-grounded writing. Prior systems typically address isolated writing phases, leaving comprehensive end-to-end human-LLM collaboration largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce CoWriter, a proactive agentic scheme that adapts expert human (co-)authoring methodologies from cognitive science to flexibly steer the entire writing workflow while actively encouraging the user to engage. translated_title: CoWriter：引导方法化与协同性的人机（人类-大语言模型）共同写作
translated_abstract: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）已经改变了文本生成方式，但标准的聊天与画布式界面往往将人类写作降格为相当被动的监督工作，导致审阅疲劳、对AI的过度依赖，以及在长篇、基于文献来源的写作中人类角色的边缘化。以往的系统通常只针对孤立的写作阶段，而对全面的端到端人机协作则大多缺乏探索。本文提出了CoWriter，这是一种主动式的智能体方案，它将来自认知科学的专家级人类（共同）写作方法论加以适配改造，以灵活引导整个写作流程，同时积极鼓励用户参与。在一项探索性用户研究中，与标准LLM基线相比，使用CoWriter的作者能够更好地表达自己的观点，并保持更高的文档主人翁感，这在定量上得到了2.2倍更多成功智能体交互的支持。此外，外部读者评判者对所生成文本的评价更高。
tldr: CoWriter是一种主动式人机协同写作智能体方案，通过借鉴认知科学中的专家写作方法论来引导端到端的完整写作流程并积极促使用户深度参与，从而显著提升作者的观点表达、文档主人翁感与文本质量。
en_tdlr: CoWriter is a proactive agentic writing system that adapts expert co-authoring methodologies from cognitive science to guide the entire writing workflow while actively engaging users, leading to better perspective expression, a stronger sense of document ownership, and higher-quality texts.
